entry.title: New: dsh-nuphus-mcp
entry.summary: Official DSH plugin for nuphus-mcp (by the nuphus-mcp maintainers): desktop and browser automation (38 tools) with PaddleOCR element perception and Chrome CDP browsing, via a persistent stdio MCP child process. Exact install spec: dsh-nuphus-mcp. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
